title: Figure 2. Typical EKG Signal for a Normal Heartbeat (P, Q, R, S, T waveform)
description: Line drawing of a single electrocardiogram cycle with the P wave, QRS complex, and T wave peaks labeled P, Q, R, S, and T. Captioned "Figure 2. Typical EKG Signal for a Normal Heartbeat. Portions of the waveform are labeled P, Q, R, S, and T." Appears under the heading "Cardiac Function" in a discussion of physiological workload measures.
